# \[MICRO 2024\] Seungjae Yoo and Hangyeol Kim’s paper on AdapTiV: Sign-Similarity based Image-Adaptive Token Merging for Vision Transformer Acceleration is accepted

Congratulations!

We have a paper accepted to ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO), 2024

“AdapTiV: Sign-Similarity based Image-Adaptive Token Merging for Vision Transformer Acceleration”

- \*Seungjae Yoo, \*Hangyeol Kim and Joo-Young Kim (\*equal contribution)
